category: D: category schemas, dimension metrics and unsourced claims (MYEZ-008, MYEZ-009, MYEZ-021)
summary: I read origin/main 683f56c0 at C:\Users\SynAckITPC\Documents\AI\sc-s80-base (root app/, SmartCompareApp/src). All three defects trace back to one design fact: the 54 per-category dimensions in CATEGORY_DIMENSIONS are not measured from category data. _DIMENSION_SIGNAL_MAP (scoring_service.py:2144-2190) relabels 7 generic signals: spec coverage, star rating, fact-check citation ratio, review-count popularity, spec/rating blend, and price/spec value. Examples: fragrance 'Projection' is the star rating (possibly a GPT-estimated one). Fashion 'Durability' is the share of spec fields whose citation checked out. Fashion 'Heritage' is the spec/rating blend. The relabelled dims then feed four outputs: (1) the bars, which are numeric but have hidden numbers, a 45-85 pair-relative band, and a sentinel 50 for a missing side; (2) the English template verdict lines 'X leads on <label>.' / 'Y pulls ahead on <label>.'; (3) the constant captions 'More distinctive', 'Longer-lasting' and 'Comparable'; (4) the GPT verdict's Scoring Context, which says 'Durability: stronger' and tells the model its verdict MUST be consistent with the scores. That is how 'The other product offers better durability' appears with no data behind it. Beard oil got fragrance dimensions because the deterministic classifier maps the bare token 'scent' to fragrances (extraction_service.py:1171), and the vision name was 'pura d'or ... SANDALWOOD SCENT'. On the camera and explicit-pair paths, name detection outranks everything (structured_comparison_service.py:483-486). The camera path never sends the user's category chip, and the vision model's own label is never used. No grooming or beard rule exists anywhere. The review sentences 'Owners consistently highlight...', 'Reviewers say...' and 'Owners say it...' are hard-coded English templates in review_service.py:446-464 (build_review_praise). Their clauses come from GPT highlights over Serper snippets for the product NAME, with no identity check. The consensus fallback carries no citation at all. Every attribution is deliberately removed (_strip_attribution), per decision D4 'Paraphrased praise, no citations'. review_count, rating and rating_source already exist on the wire. retailer_quotes (domain + real snippet) and the 'Per <domain>:' highlights also ship but are not rendered (Contract 2). No review_source field exists, and the praise line has no source of its own: its stars come from a different provider. On a full cache hit no search runs, so provenance cannot be rebuilt per request; it must be stored at extraction time. No existing flag fixes any of the three defects. Related flags are all default OFF, and CLAUDE.md records none as ON in prod. Partial helps that cannot be flipped quickly: ENABLE_SPEC_FIELD_NORM; ENABLE_SPECS_NO_FABRICATION (must flip last); ENABLE_RELIABILITY_UNCHECKED_ABSENCE (stays inert unless ENABLE_MISSING_DIM_RENORM is ON); ENABLE_VERDICT_PROMPT_TRUTH (prod state unrecorded). ENABLE_CATEGORY_TOKEN_FIX only vetoes 'tablet'. The proposed fixes are backend-only and use contract keys the build-3 client already honours. caption_key:'limited_data' makes DimensionBars and RunnerUpWinsCard drop a row. New keys ride along additively. Each fix sits behind a new dark flag, default OFF and read per call. Client polish waits for a post-approval OTA: respecting winner:null, a descriptive-scale caption, and source counts.

defects.root_cause: Two compounding causes. (A) Category mis-selection. classify_category_from_text sweeps _CATEGORY_SYNONYMS longest-first with \b matching. The generic token 'scent'/'scents' maps to 'fragrances' (extraction_service.py:1171-1172, loop at :1332), so any scented non-perfume name, such as a beard oil 'SANDALWOOD SCENT', becomes fragrances. On the vision and explicit-pair paths _resolve_pair_category lets name detection win over everything: det = name_cat, and the chip only marks category_switched (structured_comparison_service.py:483-486). The camera route never receives a chip: image_routes.py:160-168 takes no category param, :450 calls compare_from_text without selected_category, and the client identify call sends only region (SmartCompareApp/src/services/api.ts:302). The vision model outputs no category, and its per-product confidence is dropped (openai_service.py:135-160; structured_comparison_service.py:4210-4224). There are 9 categories and no grooming or beard rule; grep finds 'beard' only in a sitemap test. category_switched has 0 client render sites (types.ts:299 only), so a switch is invisible to the user. (B) The category 'metrics' are not category metrics. Each of the 6 dims per category is a relabel of one of 7 generic signals via ScoringService._DIMENSION_SIGNAL_MAP (scoring_service.py:2144-2190). Fragrance: character = spec coverage, longevity = spec_secondary, projection = star rating, versatility = fact-check reliability, presentation = popularity. Fashion: craft = spec, fit = star rating, style = popularity, durability = reliability, heritage = spec_secondary, cpw = value. _normalize_scores applies the map at :2386-2405. 'Durability' for a shirt is therefore (verified*1+likely*0.7+unverified*0.3)/total over spec citation grades plus a price-verified bonus (:2071-2106). It is not a durability measurement. Fashion has no higher/lower-is-better fields (:262-283), so 'Craftsmanship' is just spec-field coverage. Fragrance spec_raw adds the raw numeric 'volume' (:269, :1925-1936), so bottle size can decide 'Character'. That fits V06, where the 118 ml pura d'or 'pulls ahead on Character' (inferred). review_raw reads product['rating'] without checking rating_derived (:1815-1818), so a GPT-estimated aggregate rating (structured_comparison_service.py:527-557) drives 'Projection' (fragrance) and 'Fit' (fashion). The core _dim_reviews excludes derived ratings (scoring_service.py:3285-3287). build_dimensions_v2 shows up to 5 of these relabelled dims per category (:3880-3905). Their labels come from _DIMENSION_LABELS (:3441-3500), translated on the client (ar.json:213-262, e.g. fit -> 'المقاس' = size). The same dims flow into the GPT verdict as 'Per dimension: Durability: stronger' plus 'Dimension leaders' (scoring_service.py:3017-3100). The prompt adds 'Your verdict MUST be consistent with the scores above' (extraction_service.py:2548-2560), so the model writes those proxies up as product facts.

defects.fix_sketch:
Backend-only. Every change sits behind a NEW dark flag, default OFF, read per call through os.getenv. No response key is removed or retyped.

D8a, ENABLE_CATEGORY_SCENT_VETO (category truth):
- Mirror the W4-8 _tablet_veto pattern for the ambiguous tokens 'scent'/'scents'. When a non-perfume product-type noun co-occurs ({beard, oil, balm, shampoo, conditioner, wash, soap, lotion, cream, butter, deodorant, candle, diffuser, freshener, detergent, wax}), `continue` the sweep instead of returning fragrances. The sweep can still hit 'hair'/'skin'; otherwise it ends at 'other', which on the vision/explicit path escalates to the bounded A2b classifier (structured_comparison_service.py:494).
- In the same unit, flag a TRUTH twin of _CLASSIFY_CATEGORY_LLM_PROMPT with one line: 'beard/grooming oils and balms -> haircare; scented personal-care, home or cleaning items are not fragrances'.
- Keep _CATEGORY_SYNONYMS untouched, because canonicalize_category shares it.
- Optional follow-up, a separate flag: add 'category' to the vision JSON and use it as llm_cat on the vision path. This touches the vision prompt.

D8b, ENABLE_DIM_EVIDENCE_GATE (display-only; scores, overall and winner untouched, so the 167-record scoring equality gate stays identical):
- Add a DIM_EVIDENCE_FIELDS map from each category dim to the schema fields that actually measure it. Examples: projection->sillage; longevity->longevity; character->scent_family|notes_*; versatility->season|occasion; craft->craftsmanship|material; fit->size_options; style->style|design_details; durability->material|care_instructions; heritage->origin|collection_season. presentation/scalp/etc. map to none.
- In _dim_from_category_lookup (scoring_service.py:3503-3589), mark the dim caption_key:'limited_data' in two cases: (i) either side was_missing; (ii) its evidence fields are absent on either product.
- This key is already honoured by build-3: DimensionBars.tsx:82-88 drops the row, and RunnerUpWinsCard.tsx:56 drops it.
- In response_builder._top_dim_candidate / _runner_up_dim_candidate (:910-969), skip limited_data dims, so factual_verdict never says 'leads on Heritage'.
- In build_scores_summary (:3017-3100), list only evidence-backed dims and never render a missing side as 50. This changes the verdict prompt only when the flag is ON. With the flag OFF, the W4-11 render-digest fixture must stay byte-identical; with it ON, regenerate it in the same PR.

D8c: under D8b's flag, review-mapped dims ignore rating_derived ratings (same rule as _dim_reviews:3285). Gate this in build_dimensions_v2, display-side, not in _compute_raw_scores.

Existing flags that partially help, but none is quick to flip:
- ENABLE_SPEC_FIELD_NORM: volume magnitude.
- ENABLE_RELIABILITY_UNCHECKED_ABSENCE: blanks an all-unverified 'Durability', but it is coupled to ENABLE_MISSING_DIM_RENORM, which is OFF.
- ENABLE_SPECS_NO_FABRICATION: must flip LAST.
- ENABLE_VERDICT_PROMPT_TRUTH: needs Ahmed's yes.

Post-approval OTA: send the Home chip on /image/identify (the backend needs an additive Query param) and render category_switched.

defects.root_cause: The people-attributed sentences are a deterministic English template. build_review_praise (review_service.py:531-630) weaves up to 2 positive review_summary.highlights clauses. Through _frame_praise_clause (:446-464) it prefixes them with 'Reviewers say', 'Owners say it is', 'Owners say it' or 'Owners consistently highlight'. When no positive highlight survives, it falls back to the GPT 'consensus' sentence (:615-630), which the extraction prompt does not require to be cited (extraction_service.py:986, :996). The highlights come from REVIEWS_EXTRACTION_SYSTEM (extraction_service.py:975-1025) over Serper organic snippets. On the live path that is the unified search '{search_query} specifications reviews price' (structured_comparison_service.py:5810-5850). No check confirms the snippets describe the same product, so a wrong or generic identity yields praise for another product (V04, V07). The prompt asks for [snippet_N] markers, but build_review_praise never checks that a clause was cited (:583-600). _strip_attribution (:365-380) then deliberately removes every 'Per <domain>:', [N] and domain token, per Ahmed's D4 'Paraphrased praise, no citations' (sc-docs-70/docs/plans/2026-06-17-faithful-results-genuine-bh-freetier-design.md:16, :27). ResultsAccordion.tsx:336-420 and ReviewPraiseBlock (:633-690) render the praise next to stars and a count from a different source: the Phase-2 rating provider's rating/review_count. rating_source is not displayed. So a sentence attributed to 'owners' carries neither its own source nor its own count. Fields that exist today: overview.products[i].rating/review_count (derived ratings nulled, response_builder.py:1917-1921); reviews.products[i].rating/review_count/rating_source/review_summary (with 'Per domain:' highlights)/retailer_quotes/review_praise/youtube_review_signal (response_builder.py:1985-2030); products[i].review_praise (response_builder.py:2187). There is no review_source field. retailer_quotes ({retailer: domain, text: real snippet, rating?}) can be traced to a source but is dormant on the client (Contract 2). On a full specs+reviews cache hit no unified search runs (structured_comparison_service.py:5808-5811), so retailer_quotes is [] and the citation markers are stripped with empty attribution. Provenance can only be kept if it is captured at extraction time inside get_reviews (review_service.py:709-726). A second, verdict-side source of unsourced claims shares MYEZ-008's mechanism: GPT key_tradeoff and pros/cons are told 'Durability: stronger' etc. and must stay 'consistent with the scores' (extraction_service.py:2548-2560). The verdict JSON has no per-claim provenance field, even though trust rule 'CITE the data' exists (prompt_personalities.py:71-80).

defects.fix_sketch:
New dark flag ENABLE_REVIEW_PRAISE_PROVENANCE, default OFF, read per call. Backend only; build-3 keeps working because the review_praise key stays a string or null.

(1) Capture provenance where the search results are in scope:
- In get_reviews, right after extract_reviews (review_service.py:709), map each positive highlight's [snippet_N] to its organic result. Use the same _CITATION_MARKER_RE logic as build_retailer_quotes_from_reviews.
- Store an additive `praise_basis` = {source_count, domains, urls, highlight_idx[], captured_at} inside the reviews dict before the cache write at :723-726, so warm compares keep it.
- Skip this for a FY19 timeout context, as today.

(2) In build_review_praise under the flag:
- Use only highlights listed in praise_basis.
- Drop the uncited consensus fallback.
- Require at least N distinct sources (N is a product call; 1 or 2); otherwise return None. build-3 then renders the rating alone or the calm 'reviewsEmpty' line, both existing behaviour.

(3) Replace the person-attributing leads with a source-neutral, count-bearing frame, e.g. 'Mentioned across N online reviews: {clause}.' This keeps D4 (paraphrase, no domains shown).
- Copy must pass the .copy-policy fence.
- English only for now; Arabic belongs with MYEZ-016 / ENABLE_ARABIC_VERDICT_OUTPUT.

(4) Additive wire keys reviews.products[i].review_praise_basis and products[i].review_praise_basis = {source_count, basis:'cited_highlights', captured_at}. Domains appear only if Ahmed revisits D4. Keep SSE parity at structured_comparison_service.py:5153-5180. build-3 ignores unknown keys; a post-approval OTA can show 'from N sources'.

(5) Identity guard, dependent on the Category A/B identity units: return None when vision confidence is 'low', when the two product names are identical (V07), or when a name is 'Unknown Product'. This needs vision confidence carried through structured_comparison_service.py:4210-4224 as a private key.

(6) Verdict side: reuse MYEZ-008 D8b so the Scoring Context no longer asserts proxy dims. A later unit (prompt plus additive contract) can request a basis per pro/con; not now.

extra_findings.title: GPT-estimated ratings drive the category dims mapped to the 'review' signal
extra_findings.evidence: scoring_service.py:1815-1818 has no rating_derived check. The affected dims are fragrance projection, fashion fit, electronics futureproof, grocery taste, supplements form, makeup longevity, haircare results, skincare skin_compat and 'other' review. Contrast _dim_reviews at scoring_service.py:3285-3287, which excludes derived ratings (measured).

extra_findings.title: The client paints a winner on bars the backend marked winner:null
extra_findings.evidence: DimensionBars.tsx:263-269 falls back to score_a > score_b, with ties going to the overall winner. This defeats _dim_winner's Decision B (scoring_service.py:3192-3237) (measured).

extra_findings.title: The verdict prompt turns relabelled proxy dims into product claims
extra_findings.evidence: scoring_service.py:3017-3100 tells GPT 'Per dimension: Durability: stronger' and 'Dimension leaders'. A missing side is read as 50 at :3068. extraction_service.py:2560 requires 'Your verdict MUST be consistent with the scores above'. Result: V07 'The other product offers better durability.' (measured code; screenshot measured).

extra_findings.title: Review provenance is lost on every warm compare
extra_findings.evidence: structured_comparison_service.py:5808-5811 skips the unified search on a specs+reviews cache hit, so build_retailer_quotes_from_reviews and clean_review_citations get [] (:6419-6440). The cached reviews dict (review_service.py:723-726) holds no source map (measured).

extra_findings.title: Fragrance 'Character' is dominated by bottle volume, and Character and Longevity show the same number when no rating exists
extra_findings.evidence: HIGHER_IS_BETTER fragrances = {longevity, volume} (scoring_service.py:269), and _score_specs adds the raw number (:1925-1936). spec_secondary falls back to spec (:2346-2350). The fixture DimensionBars.test.tsx:140-141 shows identical bars (measured). V06's 118 ml bottle 'pulls ahead on Character' (inferred).

extra_findings.title: The Arabic label for 'Fit' reads 'Size' (المقاس)
extra_findings.evidence: SmartCompareApp/src/i18n/ar.json:229 "results.dimension.fit": "المقاس". The audit reports V07 as 'المقاس' (size) with no data; the bar is actually the star-rating signal (measured).

extra_findings.title: English-only dynamic strings in the dimension and verdict surfaces under the Arabic UI (MYEZ-016 overlap)
extra_findings.evidence: The factual_verdict templates 'leads on {label}.' / 'pulls ahead on {label}.' use English _DIMENSION_LABELS (response_builder.py:1063-1121; scoring_service.py:3441-3500). The delta constants are English (scoring_service.py:3608-3687), and so is the praise template (review_service.py:446-464) (measured).

extra_findings.title: V06 key_tradeoff makes a price claim against a product whose price is pending
extra_findings.evidence: Screenshot dd4b9146: 'Pura d'or offers a larger volume at a lower price.' while Goiple shows 'لا يوجد سعر مؤكد بعد'. COMPARISON_SYSTEM's PENDING PRICE rule (extraction_service.py, COMPARISON_SYSTEM RULES) forbids this (inferred: model non-compliance).

extra_findings.title: Vision per-product confidence is discarded before compare
extra_findings.evidence: openai_service.py:144 defines confidence high/medium/low. structured_comparison_service.py:4210-4224 keeps only brand/name/size_or_count, so nothing downstream can suppress dims or praise for a low-confidence identity (measured).
